description: An if directive in a file that starts with a byte order mark is an if directive
notes: The spec says byte order marks are not permitted (native/lexical/byte-order-mark-at-start). hashicorp/hcl deliberately skips a leading UTF-8 byte order mark (scanTokens in hclsyntax/scan_tokens.rl) and still counts its bytes in source positions, so the rest of the file, here an if directive, reads as it would without it.
